title: Do Not Ditch the Pitch Deck
primary_theme: Founder uniqueness and learning velocity in early-stage investing
founder_lessons: Show what you will do differently in the market and why your insight is unique.
Let investors observe your learning velocity as you go deeper into a market over time.
Use early conversations as collaborative problem solving, not only judgment.
Prepare enough context for the investor to understand what drew you to the space, the idea, and the moment.
notable_quotes: we need to be able to hang our hat on some elements of uniqueness
